title: 📝General Updates
author: Jonathan Hill
excerpt: Hey @everyone, here to deliver some updates completed in the past week! 🍷 Impetus of Dionysus can now hand-brew custom potions you've unlocked via mcMMO alchemy. 🧍The armor stand editing GUI now has a name tag button for toggling…
body:
Hey @everyone, here to deliver some updates completed in the past week!

  • 🍷Impetus of Dionysus can now hand-brew custom potions you've unlocked via mcMMO alchemy.

  • 🧍The armor stand editing GUI now has a name tag button for toggling visibility of its name. This also works for Mob Scarecrows.

  • 🐗Mob Scarecrows now prevent zombified piglins spawns and only lose 0-1 Withered Hearts when broken while upgraded.

  • 🧙‍♀️The spawn secret hints given by the boardwalk clairvoyant now include the number of the hinted secret.

  • 🟧Added `/creative_world` as a master command for managing creative world settings, including two new subcommands:

    • 🕰️`/creative_world time <time>` - Sets a personal creative world time-of-day override. Accepts `dawn`, `dusk`, `night`, or `reset`.

    • 🌧️`/creative_world weather <weather>` - Sets a personal creative world weather override. Accepts `rain` or `reset`.

    • There are also `home` and `particle_wand` subcommands which simply act as aliases to `/creativehome` and `/particlewand`.

    • Using just `/creative_world` on its own acts as an alias to `/warp creative`.

🫶
